title: Two fitted wardrobes in IKEA PAX

options.name: Wardrobe by the door
options.text: Three shaker doors on IKEA PAX frames 2364 high, with a top box above to the ceiling and wooden knobs. Inside, a 500 unit of six shelves on the left, and a 750 unit on the right with three drawers, a shelf, short hanging and a top shelf.

poster.alt: 3D model of a three-door PAX wardrobe with shelves on the left and drawers under a hanging rail on the right

options.name: Wardrobe along the side wall
options.text: Six shaker doors on IKEA PAX frames 2364 high, with top boxes above to the ceiling and wooden knobs. Inside, two 750 units with three drawers, a shelf, short hanging and a top shelf, and a 1000 unit by the window with long hanging under a top shelf.

poster.alt: 3D model of a six-door PAX wardrobe with drawers under short hanging in two units and long hanging in the third

notes: The widths come from the room plan and the ceiling height of about 2800 mm is still to be measured.
The depth is the standard PAX depth with the doors, and the layouts inside are standard ones to start from: shelves, drawers and rails can change.
Built on IKEA PAX frames, with a top box above each one up to the ceiling.
Colours on screen are a guide.
